note: Phase 4 authoritative execution manifest. Support-only matrix harness and workbook helper coverage stay outside the authoritative row inventory.

support_go_targets.migration_scratch_reason: Replays the pre-record-envelope boundary to verify record envelope backfill behavior.

unit.claim: Timeline mention fields prove `mention_origin` binding while representative Host and Identity writable plus alias fields prove `entity_origin`, and the store writes mentions versus entity rows without synthesizing the other substrate.
unit.out_of_scope: HTTP route behavior and browser-visible resolution flows remain integration or browser evidence.

unit.claim: Repeated identical mention tokens persist as separate durable mentions with distinct provenance locators, mention ids, and source-row attachment.
unit.out_of_scope: Interactive resolve and dismiss route behavior remains integration and browser evidence.

unit.claim: Create-from-mention store paths promote unresolved mentions into durable Host or Identity rows with stable lineage and immediate relationship state.
unit.out_of_scope: The live resolve route and current-state HTTP readback remain integration evidence.

unit.claim: Dismiss and restore store operations preserve raw mention text, mutate durable mention status correctly, and couple link removal or restoration to the lifecycle transition.
unit.out_of_scope: Route idempotency and authorization re-derivation remain integration evidence.

unit.claim: Exact-match precedence resolves reuse decisions through the owned identifier hierarchy and keeps suggestion-only aliases out of authoritative reuse.
unit.out_of_scope: HTTP conflict payload shape and browser-visible merge prompts remain higher-layer evidence.

unit.claim: Explicit merge store behavior repoints live mentions, links, and dependent rows onto the survivor while preserving loser lineage and replay stability.
unit.out_of_scope: HTTP merge route envelopes, websocket invalidation, and auth checks remain integration evidence.

unit.claim: Indicator storage keeps source-bound observations separate while fanning them into one canonical indicator record and lifecycle projection state.
unit.out_of_scope: Current-state route readback and live authorization remain integration evidence.

unit.claim: Timeline request decoding preserves authoritative raw mention text, applies shared mention-token normalization, and accepts suppressor or forbidden rewrite tokens without silently rewriting them.
unit.out_of_scope: Durable mention persistence and auto-match side effects remain store or integration evidence.

unit.claim: Timeline create and patch decoding accepts manual relationship actions only when client confidence or provenance metadata is omitted and fails closed on override attempts.
unit.out_of_scope: Committed relationship mutations, replay, and current-state route readback remain integration evidence.

integration.claim: The mention resolve route persists durable resolve, dismiss, and revert transitions through the live HTTP surface with replay stability, websocket invalidation, and live target validation.
integration.out_of_scope: Browser inspector workflows remain browser evidence.

integration.claim: Host and Identity create routes reuse exact matches, keep suggestion-only aliases non-authoritative, expose contract-conformant current-state rows, reject unauthenticated or CSRF-invalid malformed create requests before body parsing without durable or websocket side effects, and rebuild deterministic entity projections through the real HTTP surface.
integration.out_of_scope: End-user browser create flows remain browser evidence.

integration.claim: The explicit merge route repoints live fan-out, preserves survivor reuse semantics, emits attributed history, and keeps loser lineage intact on Hosts and Identities.
integration.out_of_scope: Browser-visible inspector merge choreography remains browser evidence.

integration.claim: Indicator create and query routes persist canonical indicators, expose contract-conformant current-state rows, and rebuild deterministic indicator projections without collapsing source-bound observations.
integration.out_of_scope: Browser-visible indicator discovery remains out of scope for this phase.

integration.claim: Timeline patch and query routes auto-resolve only eligible exact matches, keep ineligible tokens unresolved, and return contract-conformant current-state rows before and after projection rebuilds.
integration.out_of_scope: Browser-visible chip rendering and inspector affordances remain browser or support-only frontend evidence.

integration.claim: Timeline create and patch routes persist manual relationship actions with null confidence only, reject override payloads, and expose contract-conformant current-state rows across create, patch, and create-from-mention paths.
integration.out_of_scope: Browser inspector workflows remain browser or support-only frontend evidence.

e2e.title: E-4-01 resolves and creates entities from Timeline mentions in the inspector
e2e.claim: The browser inspector resolves existing entities and creates new entities from Timeline mentions through the real end-user flow.
e2e.out_of_scope: Lower-level route replay and store substrate assertions remain backend evidence.

e2e.title: E-4-02 dismisses and ordinarily restores a mention without relinking
e2e.claim: The browser inspector dismisses a mention and restores it to unresolved state without silently relinking it.
e2e.out_of_scope: Mention substrate mutation details remain backend evidence.

e2e.title: E-4-03 merges duplicate entities from the inspector and preserves survivor identity
e2e.claim: The browser inspector merges duplicate entities through the end-user flow while preserving the survivor identity in the UI.
e2e.out_of_scope: Detailed fan-out repointing and projection substrate assertions remain backend evidence.

e2e.title: E-4-04 auto-resolves only eligible exact-match Timeline tokens
e2e.claim: The browser workbook shows auto-resolution only for eligible exact-match Timeline tokens and leaves ineligible tokens unresolved.
e2e.out_of_scope: Decoder normalization details and route-level projection rebuild assertions remain backend evidence.

e2e.title: E-4-05 creates append-only assessment history through the workbook UI
e2e.claim: The browser workbook creates append-only assessment rows through the Assessments surface with band-first confidence, rationale, support refs, default ordering, and state or confidence filters.
e2e.out_of_scope: Assessment storage, projection determinism, idempotency, and validation remain backend evidence.

e2e.title: E-4-06 creates and edits Notes, Task Requests, and Decisions through generic workbook surfaces
e2e.claim: The browser workbook creates and edits Notes, Task Requests, and Decisions through their real generic workbook surfaces, including defaults, collections, and visible validation failure.
e2e.out_of_scope: Detailed lifecycle transition and idempotency assertions remain backend integration evidence.
